collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART V (81-100, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager leaning on an old hut post notices the notches that marked how tall they grew each year.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: On one of the old hut posts there are little notches carved at different heights. (name1)'s parents used to mark how tall (he/she) was every year. The lowest notch is about knee high. The highest is a little below (his/her) chin. Today, leaning against the post, (name1) notices them for the first time in years.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) runs (his/her) thumb down the notches, one by one. Some years were big jumps. Some were barely anything. (He/She) tries to remember who (he/she) was at each one. Some years come back clearly. Some don't. (He/She) leaves the post as it is.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (name1) stands with (his/her) back to the post and carefully carves a new notch at the top of (his/her) head. It's barely above the last one. (He/She) looks at the whole row: a little person growing up the post, year after year, until (he/she) stopped. (name1) touches the bottom notch and smiles.
